gzip_options_default.description: Default options string for gzip. Use standard CLI options like '-9', '-6 --best', or '-1 --fast'. Must be a single space-separated string.

gzip_compression_rules.description: Per-file pattern compression tuning rules. Each rule specifies a glob pattern and compression level for matching files. Applied only during compression (not decompression).

gzip_suffix.description: Suffix to use for compressed files instead of .gz. Should be non-empty only for legacy compatibility. Not recommended for general use.

gzip_rsyncable.description: If true, enable rsyncable compression for efficient incremental syncs of compressed archives. May reduce compression ratio slightly.
